September 26, 2026


This week, Cameco was proud to sponsor the ISSA Mining Safety Conference in Saskatoon, welcoming more than 700 delegates and 84 exhibiting companies from more than 27 countries to discuss the future of mining safety. In addition to participating on the organizing committee, more than 20 Cameco employees contributed to the conference through presentations, panel discussions, session chair roles and the AI4SafeMines student competition. Events like ISSA remind us that while companies may compete in business, sharing experiences, lessons learned and leading practices across borders helps strengthen our industry and ensure everyone goes home safe. Thank you to everyone who helped make this year's conference such a memorable opportunity to share knowledge, exchange ideas and build connections with mining professionals from around the world. 🌍
